WITH town_scope AS ( SELECT DISTINCT level, county, trim(streets) AS street FROM dz_def_resp_plan WHERE type = 2 AND region_scope_type = 2 AND COALESCE(deleted, 0) = 0 AND streets IS NOT NULL AND trim(streets) != ''
AND parent_def_id = #{parentDefId} AND status IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6) AND execute_status IN (0, 1, 3)
AND status IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5) AND execute_status IN (0, 1) AND close_time IS NULL
), town_stats AS ( SELECT level, COUNT(*) AS town_count FROM town_scope GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((level), ()) ), area_stats AS ( SELECT ts.level, SUM(COALESCE(ar.area, 0)) AS area_square_kilometer FROM town_scope ts LEFT JOIN data_ad_region ar ON ar.level = 4 AND ar.county = ts.county AND ar.street = ts.street GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((ts.level), ()) ), disaster_stats AS ( SELECT ts.level, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(hp.unique_disaster_id, ''), hp.id)) AS disaster_point_count FROM town_scope ts LEFT JOIN data_hazard_point hp ON hp.street = ts.street AND COALESCE(hp.is_cancelled, 0) = 0 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((ts.level), ()) ) SELECT t.level, COALESCE(t.town_count, 0) AS town_count, COALESCE(a.area_square_kilometer, 0) AS area_square_kilometer, 0 AS population_ten_thousand, COALESCE(d.disaster_point_count, 0) AS disaster_point_count FROM town_stats t LEFT JOIN area_stats a ON a.level IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.level LEFT JOIN disaster_stats d ON d.level IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.level ORDER BY t.level DESC NULLS FIRST

SELECT level, status, execute_status, create_date, update_date, county, street FROM ( SELECT level, status, execute_status, create_date, update_date, county, trim(streets) AS street, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY level, county, trim(streets) ORDER BY update_date DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC ) AS rn FROM dz_def_resp_plan WHERE type = 2 AND region_scope_type = 2 AND COALESCE(deleted, 0) = 0 AND streets IS NOT NULL AND trim(streets) != ''
AND parent_def_id = #{parentDefId} AND status IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6) AND execute_status IN (0, 1, 3)
AND status IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5) AND execute_status IN (0, 1) AND close_time IS NULL
) t WHERE rn = 1

SELECT level FROM dz_def_resp_plan WHERE type = 2 AND region_scope_type = 1 AND status IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5) AND COALESCE(deleted, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(execute_status, 0) NOT IN (2, 3) AND close_time IS NULL ORDER BY update_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
